versions.changelog:
- Initial release of "Script to Shot List" (口播稿转分镜), version 0.1.0.
- Breaks a voiceover/script into a detailed, shootable shot list including shot number, visual description, framing, duration, subtitles, props, with total duration estimate and shooting difficulty.
- Strictly requires seven fields per shot and avoids vague or unfilmable descriptions.
- Auto-adapts for missing inputs (defaults to single camera, indoor, vertical video).
- Adds suggestions for lower-complexity, minimum-setup alternatives when shooting resources are limited.
